question: Does linking the selected Windows main VS_VERSIONINFO resource produce an otherwise unchanged private image suitable for a scoped startup comparison?

source.factor: The private variant still generated all five identical version resources but omitted the selected main resource linker directive; the four other linker directives remained.

build.method: Sequential private default-feature release builds at the same source and target paths, each archived and fully rehashed before path reuse.
build.profile: opt3, LTO, codegen units 1, panic abort, stripped symbols, offline locked, warnings as errors

existing_feature_static_bound.scope: Separate archived current-source opt3 builds using default versus all-features build contexts; their recipes were not otherwise identical.
existing_feature_static_bound.reason_no_fresh_feature_build: The existing static comparison bounded this build difference; it did not establish isolated feature causality or timing equivalence.

limits: The private resource-free image lacks required product version metadata and is ineligible for adoption.
Different nonresource PE bytes fail the preregistered comparability gate; no performance result or resource-link startup effect was measured.
The changed bytes do not identify whether compiler code generation, linker layout, address dependencies or another build effect produced them.
No product runtime test or comprehensive benchmark was run for this factor. Exact build and PE custody remains private.
